scope: Targeted primary-source comparison. This index records source locations and inspection limits; it does not certify priority or mathematical correctness.

sources.title: Uncertainty about Uncertainty: Optimal Adaptive Algorithms for Estimating Mixtures of Unknown Coins
locations: Section 5.2, true-bias revelation after a cap
sources.relevant_hypotheses: Section 7 receives the two sign-conditional bias laws, a nominal mixture weight, and a per-coin cap. The robust known-magnitude class in the present paper does not fix those conditional laws.
sources.inspection: Relevant theorem statements and arguments inspected. Direct antecedent used in related work.

sources.title: Open Problem: Best Arm Identification: Almost Instance-Wise Optimality and the Gap Entropy Conjecture
sources.relevance: Introduces entropy of normalized dyadic inverse-square gap costs in best-arm identification.
sources.inspection: Relevant definitions and conjecture inspected. Attribution of the cost-entropy structure.

sources.title: Towards Instance Optimal Bounds for Best Arm Identification
locations: Appendix D, stopping windows and Kraft argument
Remark D.4, quadratic-KL and Bernoulli extension
sources.relevant_hypotheses: The sign-testing argument treats separated gap scales; the Bernoulli extension uses means bounded away from zero and one.
sources.inspection: Relevant statement, proof mechanism, and Bernoulli extension inspected.
sources.baseline_attribution: The pinned version-5 critical appendix already cites Lemma 4.1 and disclaims novelty for the entropy mechanism.

sources.title: Nonparametric estimation by convex programming
sources.relevant_hypotheses: Good observation/function pairs, compact convex parameter set, affine observation parametrization. Product experiments are prescribed. Adaptation in Section 5 concerns parameter classes.
sources.inspection: Relevant statements and hypotheses inspected. Convex estimation/testing antecedent.

sources.title: Dualizing Le Cam's method for functional estimation, with applications to estimating the unseens
locations: Theorem 1, assumptions A1-A4 and iid risk bounds
sources.relevant_hypotheses: Fixed iid observation kernel, affine functional, convex prior class, dense function space, and compactness/continuity assumptions.
sources.inspection: Theorem and hypotheses inspected. Fixed-kernel estimation/testing antecedent; does not itself supply the present policy/work optimization.
